description: Fetch the full-day block schedule for a vehicle by block ID. A block is the ordered sequence of trips a single vehicle makes in one service day. Returns all trips in order with their stop times. Useful for 'when will this bus return?' and fleet tracking. Block IDs appear as blockId in onebusaway_get_trip responses; obtain a tripId from onebusaway_get_arrivals first.

blockId.description: Block ID from a trip record. Obtain a tripId from onebusaway_get_arrivals, then call onebusaway_get_trip to get the blockId.

name: onebusaway_get_block

activeServiceIds.description: Service calendar IDs active for this block today.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `block_not_found`: Block ID does not exist on this instance. `rate_limited`: No upstream request slot opened within the queue wait cap, or OneBusAway returned a rate limit response. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

inactiveServiceIds.description: Service calendar IDs not active for this block today.

trips.description: All trips in this block in order.

items.description: A trip in this vehicle block.

accumulatedSlackTime.description: Accumulated layover/slack time (seconds) before this trip starts.

blockStopTimes.description: Ordered stop times for this trip.

items.description: A scheduled stop time within this trip.

arrivalTime.description: Scheduled arrival time as seconds from midnight (GTFS format).

departureTime.description: Scheduled departure time as seconds from midnight (GTFS format).

dropOffType.description: GTFS drop-off type (0=regular, 1=no dropoff, 2=phone agency, 3=coordinate with driver).

pickupType.description: GTFS pickup type (0=regular, 1=no pickup, 2=phone agency, 3=coordinate with driver).

distanceAlongBlock.description: Cumulative distance (meters) from block start to the first stop of this trip.

tripId.description: Trip ID for follow-up onebusaway_get_trip calls.

title: Get Block Schedule
